violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))
violation_type.typical_finding: The allegation is related to a DFPS abuse/neglect investigation and found to be deficient. Based on interviews with children and daycare staff, it was determined a caregiver used profane language towards children in care.

finding_variants.text: The allegation is related to a DFPS abuse/neglect investigation and found to be deficient. Based on interviews with children and daycare staff, it was determined a caregiver used profane language towards children in care.
While conducting interviews two people overheard a caregiver yelling at a child.
During a DFPS investigation, the investigator heard a caregiver yelling a children.
It was found that caregivers raise their voice as a method of discipline.
Based on information received, as a form of time-out discipline, children are made to stand facing a corner or wall for an unknown amount of time.
This standard was evaluated during an investigation and determined to be deficient. A caregiver has used harsh and profane language in the presence of children.
